adjudication.rationale: In addGuests.handler.ts, existing-attendee deduplication uses a strict, case-sensitive comparison: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`. Since neither `guest` nor `attendee.email` is normalized (e.g., to lowercase) anywhere in this diff (schema just validates `.email()`), inputs like `Foo@Bar.com` will not match an existing attendee stored as `foo@bar.com`, allowing a duplicate attendee record to be created via `attendees.createMany`. This can also lead to duplicate calendar/email notifications for what is effectively the same email address.
